theme: The Mending: The Death of the Old Gods — Time Spiral to Future Sight
status: FINISHED STORY-FIRST PROPOSAL — not yet approved/locked by Cory
narrator_note: Jodah is a long-lived Dominarian chronicler and five-color color-identity gateway, not the actor who personally sealed every rift; the story centers Teferi, Jhoira, Karn, Venser, Radha and Jeska.
canon_caveats: Death of the old gods is metaphorical: the Mending changes planeswalker powers and immortality, though not all old planeswalkers die.
Time Spiral, Planar Chaos, Future Sight are publication labels; only the cited official statements and original printings support scenes. Never assign invented years.
Many cards are symbolic, antecedents or later epilogues rather than direct scenes; evidence labels are explicit.
Jeska's sacrifice closes the final great rift in Otaria, according to official Wizards Jeska biography.
Teferi's spark loss at Shiv, Freyalise's and Windgrace's deaths, and Karn's sacrifice at Tolaria are distinct events, not one spell.
Jodah does not usurp Jeska as protagonist; he serves as five-color narrative framing.

beats.title: I. Wounds before the rifts — the war, Tolaria, Zhalfir, and Otaria

cards.name: Urza's Sylex
cards.why: Urza's blast at Argoth, a historical catastrophe in Dominaria's long accumulation of planar damage.

cards.name: Urza's Ruinous Blast
cards.why: Retrospective account of the Brothers' War Sylex devastation and Ice Age; this 2018 printing is not an eyewitness card.

cards.name: Time of Ice
cards.why: Saga recording the world-changing Ice Age that followed the Brothers' War.

cards.name: Urza, Lord High Artificer
cards.why: The old Planeswalker whose experiments and wars left long-term damage behind.

cards.name: Barrin, Master Wizard
cards.why: Urza's collaborator and witness to Tolarian temporal experimentation; his final act matters to Tolaria's wound.

cards.name: Obliterate
cards.why: Use the original Invasion printing, whose printed flavor directly describes Barrin's funeral pyre for Tolaria.

cards.name: The Phasing of Zhalfir
cards.why: A retrospective Saga of Teferi's removal of Zhalfir during the Phyrexian invasion, an unresolved wound during Mending.

cards.name: Legacy Weapon
cards.why: The Phyrexian Invasion and Yawgmoth's destruction form the immediate prior era; this is an antecedent, not a Mending scene.

cards.name: Mirari
cards.why: The wish-granting artifact central to Otaria's magical upheaval and the chain of transformations that follows.

cards.name: Kamahl, Fist of Krosa
cards.why: Jeska's brother and Krosan druid; his violent acts and later reunion frame her eventual decision.

cards.name: Jeska, Warrior Adept
cards.why: Jeska's original mortal identity before the Phage and Karona transformations.

cards.name: Phage the Untouchable
cards.why: Jeska's corrupted identity after Kamahl wounds her with the Mirari sword.

cards.name: Akroma, Angel of Wrath
cards.why: One of the three entities whose collision produces Karona, linking the Otarian story to the later final rift.

cards.name: Karona, False God
cards.why: The being formed from Jeska/Phage, Akroma and Zagorka; her emergence helps explain the final Otarian rift.

cards.name: Mirari's Wake
cards.why: Select the Modern Horizons 2 #291 printing: its flavor explicitly remembers Karona as a false god, the Mirari sword that slew her, and magic torn from Dominaria; a direct bridge from Otaria's prelude into the crisis.

beats.title: II. The Time Spiral — a broken, dying Dominaria

cards.name: Temporal Eddy
cards.why: Its Time Spiral flavor explicitly describes fractured time, past/future visitors, and present-day disappearances.

cards.name: Paradox Haze
cards.why: Teferi gives a first-person warning about meeting one's own past and future selves.

cards.name: Ground Rift
cards.why: Its printed Time Spiral flavor directly describes the earth itself vanishing through time rifts.

cards.name: Deep-Sea Kraken
cards.why: Original flavor describes an ancient monster emerging from a temporary rift.

cards.name: Foriysian Interceptor
cards.why: The original flavor names Foriys as a focus of time rifts.

cards.name: Sudden Death
cards.why: Original flavor describes rift-powered alternate timelines manifesting lethal outcomes.

cards.name: Ancient Grudge
cards.why: The Time Spiral flavor specifically says Yavimaya's rifts bring its old enemies back.

cards.name: Return to Dust
cards.why: The original flavor describes timeline branches and sudden endings.

cards.name: Sage of Epityr
cards.why: Original flavor directly says the widening rifts maddened diviners and awakened strange foresight.

cards.name: Gemhide Sliver
cards.why: Freyalise's original quoted lament about depleted Skyshroud gives the dying land a voice.

cards.name: Greenseeker
cards.why: Original flavor describes rumors of Freyalise alive in the ruins of Skyshroud.

cards.name: Telekinetic Sliver
cards.why: Freyalise's original quotation on how slivers respond to threat; illustrates her rift-era investigations.

cards.name: Stonebrow, Krosan Hero
cards.why: Original flavor literally shows a rift displacing him into the wasteland of Krosa.

cards.name: Magus of the Candelabra
cards.why: Teferi's remark to Jhoira compares Urza's legacy with his apprentices' work.

cards.name: Squall Line
cards.why: Original flavor describes severe storms created by the shredded timeline.

cards.name: Rift Elemental
cards.why: Teferi's Future Sight quote directly discusses the difficulty of healing wandering rifts.

cards.name: Retether
cards.why: Planar Chaos flavor explicitly describes divergent alternate histories spilling from the rifts.

cards.name: Timecrafting
cards.why: The Planar Chaos flavor comments on spellcasters tinkering with unstable time streams.

cards.name: Fury Sliver
cards.why: Time Spiral's eyewitness account from Adom Capashen describes motion frozen by a rift during combat.

beats.title: III. The old and new Planeswalkers confront the catastrophe

cards.name: Teferi, Mage of Zhalfir
cards.why: The central time mage; the original Time Spiral card's flavor foreshadows his terrible choice.

cards.name: Jhoira of the Ghitu
cards.why: The original Future Sight card of Teferi's immortal artificer ally and field companion.

cards.name: Venser, Shaper Savant
cards.why: The nascent artificer-planeswalker, central to confronting the rifts; original Future Sight depiction.

cards.name: Radha, Heir to Keld
cards.why: The young Keldon elf whose connection to the rifts proves central to Jeska's healing attempts.

cards.name: Karn, Silver Golem
cards.why: The original silver golem, later a Planeswalker who sacrifices his spark to seal the Tolarian rift.

cards.name: Freyalise, Llanowar's Fury
cards.why: Oldwalker protector who gives her life to close the Skyshroud rift.

cards.name: Lord Windgrace
cards.why: Oldwalker protector who gives his life to close the Urborg rift and binds himself to the land.

cards.name: Jeska, Thrice Reborn
cards.why: Jeska's three incarnations and her eventual final sacrifice in Otaria are the deck's emotional climax.

cards.name: Nicol Bolas
cards.why: The ancient elder dragon returns to Dominaria's conflict and opposes Leshrac around the Madaran rift.

cards.name: Myojin of Night's Reach
cards.why: The Kamigawan divinity whose mask plays a role in Leshrac's machinations against Bolas.

cards.name: Leshrac's Sigil
cards.why: Named Ice Age card acknowledging Leshrac, one of the old Planeswalkers active at Madara; this is symbolic, not direct scene depiction.

cards.name: Leshrac's Rite
cards.why: Older printed flavor quotes a pledge to Leshrac; symbolizes his power, not the Madaran rift itself.

cards.name: Multani, Maro-Sorcerer
cards.why: The Yavimayan guardian who confronts Jeska during the Yavimaya rift crisis.

cards.name: Jaya Ballard, Task Mage
cards.why: Original Time Spiral-era card for the surviving Oldwalker; a witness to the epoch, not a rift-sealer.

cards.name: Venser's Sliver
cards.why: Time Spiral flavor describes Venser building an autonomous sliver prototype; his early ingenuity.

cards.name: Jhoira's Timebug
cards.why: Jhoira's Time Spiral device for manipulating suspended phenomena; an exact artifact from the crisis set.

cards.name: Venser's Diffusion
cards.why: Venser's Future Sight card philosophizes about nested realities.

beats.title: IV. Closing the wounds — sacrifice and a reborn world

cards.name: Teferi's Protection
cards.why: Later card named for Teferi: symbolic of his defense of Shiv, achieved by sacrificing his spark; not literal printed incident.

cards.name: Windgrace's Judgment
cards.why: Later tribute to the Planeswalker who gave his life for Urborg; use as thematic sacrifice, not a literal rift-closing spell.

cards.name: Karn's Temporal Sundering
cards.why: Later flavor recounts how attempts to harness time spiraled into disaster; evocative of the Tolarian catastrophe and Karn's work.

cards.name: Riftsweeper
cards.why: Future Sight flavor explicitly condemns rift-born creatures and shows the effort to repair reality.

cards.name: Freyalise's Radiance
cards.why: Named light of Freyalise from Coldsnap, symbolizing her final heroic expenditure; not a depiction of the Skyshroud closure.

cards.name: Jeska's Will
cards.why: Use the Commander Legends printing addressed by Jeska to Radha, reflecting the crucial partnership in the final repair.

cards.name: Mox Amber
cards.why: Select The Brothers' War Retro Artifacts special printing that explicitly names a crystallized moment from the Mending Era; retrospective.

cards.name: The Mending of Dominaria
cards.why: The retrospective Saga explicitly named for the outcome: Dominaria's healing and renewal.

cards.name: Llanowar Envoy
cards.why: Dominaria flavor explicitly cites The Mending of Dominaria and honors the martyrs who saved the world.

cards.name: Magus of the Vineyard
cards.why: Future Sight flavor depicts new growth after a ruined and salt-battered age.

cards.name: Wrap in Vigor
cards.why: Future Sight flavor explicitly describes temporal energy being mistaken for life-giving magic.

cards.name: Song of Freyalise
cards.why: Dominaria Saga remembers Freyalise's protection of the woodlands and her enduring legacy.

cards.name: Relic of Legends
cards.why: A later quote by Teferi considers history's best moments returning, a hopeful epilogue.

cards.name: Timeless Lotus
cards.why: Dominaria United flavor describes old Urza-era machinery restored by nature, a late post-Mending epilogue.

cards.name: Windgrace Acolyte
cards.why: Dominaria printing shows Windgrace's adherents keeping his guardianship alive after his sacrifice.

cards.name: Krosan Druid
cards.why: Dominaria flavor confirms Krosa's renewal after calamity.

cards.name: Tolarian Scholar
cards.why: Dominaria flavor shows the later academies carefully remembering the original island's disastrous experiments.

cards.name: Temporal Isolation
cards.why: Original Time Spiral card representing the isolation and temporal displacement surrounding the repair; visual/contextual, not a named closure.

beats.title: V. Lands as historical map and aftermath

cards.name: Tolarian Academy
cards.why: Original center of Urza's dangerous time experiments; banned but included under Cory's story-first policy.

cards.name: Academy Ruins
cards.why: Time Spiral printing of the wreckage of the original Academy; exact historical aftermath.

cards.name: Tolaria West
cards.why: Future Sight location where Jhoira's later school and post-disaster researchers regroup.

cards.name: Zhalfirin Void
cards.why: Post-Mending land and Teferi quotation preserving the tragedy of Zhalfir's absence.

cards.name: Shivan Reef
cards.why: Shiv, where Teferi sacrificed his spark to repair a rift.

cards.name: Shivan Gorge
cards.why: The Shivan home of Jhoira and the Ghitu, central to Teferi's reparative choice.

cards.name: Skyshroud Forest
cards.why: Freyalise's forest and the Skyshroud rift she died repairing.

cards.name: Urborg, Tomb of Yawgmoth
cards.why: Original Planar Chaos printing directly quotes Windgrace on Yawgmoth's corpse poisoning Urborg.

cards.name: Yavimaya, Cradle of Growth
cards.why: The world-forest's spirit and landscape, where Multani confronted Jeska.

cards.name: Yavimaya Coast
cards.why: The coast of Yavimaya's damaged forest; contextual geography.

cards.name: Krosan Verge
cards.why: Otarian region tied to Kamahl, Jeska and the final temporal crisis.

cards.name: Keldon Megaliths
cards.why: Keld, Radha's homeland and the warlord culture she returns to.

cards.name: Terramorphic Expanse
cards.why: Original Time Spiral flavor literally sets out four directions in an unsettled temporal landscape.

cards.name: Llanowar Reborn
cards.why: Future Sight land named for the restored woods after centuries of devastation.

cards.name: New Benalia
cards.why: Future Sight land named for the recovering post-Mending society.

cards.name: Urza's Factory
cards.why: Urza's surviving industrial legacy, an antecedent to the temporal experiments; select Time Spiral printing.

cards.name: Saltcrusted Steppe
cards.why: Time Spiral storage land portraying the desiccated and salt-scarred world.

cards.name: Riftstone Portal
cards.why: An older Otarian portal landmark from Judgment; contextual, not presented as the final rift itself.

cards.name: Gemstone Caverns
cards.why: Time Spiral-era Dominaria landmark, used as a period artifact of the unstable geography.

cards.name: Hall of Tagsin
cards.why: The oldest Thran/Urza precursor of the cataclysm; a historical framing landmark, not a site of the Mending.
